scope: Read-only AST checks for explicit JavaScript, JSX, TypeScript, and TSX files.
resultMeaning: Exit 0 means only that the documented supported subset produced no findings. It is not Frame compliance, design-quality, accessibility, behavior, or visual certification.

diagnostics.syntax: Direct static JSX className values and value-producing conditional/logical branches: bracket-hex values and documented Tailwind palette classes.
diagnostics.falsePositiveBoundary: Only exact documented class shapes in value-producing positions are reported; comparison operands and arbitrary helper-call arguments are not treated as class values.
diagnostics.falseNegativeBoundary: Dynamic classes, helper return values, CSS files, alternate color syntax, token existence, generated CSS, themes, and contrast are not checked.
diagnostics.humanReview: Verify semantic role, token availability, both themes, and rendered contrast.

diagnostics.syntax: Direct properties in a JSX style object whose static color/background value begins with hex, rgb, or rgba syntax.
diagnostics.falsePositiveBoundary: Only color or background* properties with those literal forms are reported.
diagnostics.falseNegativeBoundary: Computed properties/values, aliases, CSS variables, hsl, nested spreads, CSS files, themes, and contrast are not checked.
diagnostics.humanReview: Verify semantic role, token availability, both themes, and rendered contrast.

diagnostics.syntax: Direct static JSX className values and value-producing conditional/logical branches: text/leading arbitrary px values and the documented native text/weight classes.
diagnostics.falsePositiveBoundary: Only exact documented class shapes in value-producing positions are reported; comparison operands and arbitrary helper-call arguments are not treated as class values.
diagnostics.falseNegativeBoundary: Dynamic classes, helper return values, other units, CSS overrides, non-class styles, and installed Frame type-tier availability are not checked.
diagnostics.humanReview: Verify readable hierarchy, the intended Frame type tier, and responsive rendering.

diagnostics.syntax: Direct static JSX className values and value-producing conditional/logical branches using numeric slash alpha on the versioned frame-check-1 utility/family profile.
diagnostics.falsePositiveBoundary: Only documented Frame token-family prefixes followed by a numeric slash modifier in value-producing positions are reported; comparison operands and arbitrary helper-call arguments are excluded.
diagnostics.falseNegativeBoundary: Dynamic classes, helper return values, unlisted future families, nonnumeric opacity syntax, and actual generated CSS are not checked.
diagnostics.humanReview: Choose an explicit semantic token and verify contrast in both themes.

diagnostics.syntax: Emoji code points in a literal aria-label or literal text directly inside an intrinsic button element.
diagnostics.falsePositiveBoundary: The advisory is restricted to two AST contexts that are unambiguously UI control labels.
diagnostics.falseNegativeBoundary: Nested button content, generated labels, ordinary strings, message copy, comments, letter substitutes, non-Lucide libraries, inline SVG, and many Unicode sequences are not checked.
diagnostics.humanReview: Confirm UI chrome uses lucide-react while preserving content and documented semantic exceptions.
